spec.description: MongoDB health, performance, resources, connections, and storage from Telegraf metrics.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "repl_state")
  |> last()
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "hostname", "node_type", "rs_name", "_measurement", "_start", "_stop"])

spec.description: Current replica set member state (1=PRIMARY, 2=SECONDARY). Non-primary/secondary states need immediate attention.
spec.title: Replica Set State

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "assert_regular" or r._field == "assert_warning" or r._field == "assert_msg" or r._field == "assert_user")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group()
  |> sum()

rest.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "assert_regular" or r._field == "assert_warning" or r._field == "assert_msg" or r._field == "assert_user")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group()
  |> sum()

spec.description: New assertions in the selected time range (regular + warning + msg + user). Any non-zero value warrants investigation.
spec.title: Assertion Error Rate

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "queries" or r._field == "inserts" or r._field == "updates" or r._field == "deletes" or r._field == "commands")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.description: Queries, inserts, updates, deletes and commands per interval. Sudden drops may indicate connection loss.
spec.title: Operation Counters

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "queries" or r._field == "inserts" or r._field == "updates" or r._field == "deletes")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.description: Relative volume of reads vs writes per interval. A useful proxy for workload character when query executor scanned fields are unavailable.
spec.title: Operation Mix

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "usage_user" or r._field == "usage_system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.cpu == "cpu-total")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.description: Host CPU user + system utilization from Telegraf cpu input.
spec.title: CPU Utilization

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "resident_megabytes" or r._field == "virtual_megabytes")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1048576.0}))

spec.description: MongoDB resident and virtual memory. Resident growing unboundedly suggests a memory leak.
spec.title: Memory Usage

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "connections_current" or r._field == "connections_available" or r._field == "connections_total_created")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.description: Current, available, and total connection pool. Connections near the limit cause new connection rejections.
spec.title: Open Connections

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cursor_timed_out" or r._field == "cursor_total_opened")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.description: Cursors that timed out waiting for results. Spikes indicate slow queries or application not closing cursors.
spec.title: Timed Out Cursors

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb_db_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node_type == "PRI")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "data_size" or r._field == "storage_size")
  |> last()
  |> drop(columns: ["_time", "_start", "_stop", "hostname", "rs_name", "node_type", "host"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["db_name"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r.data_size) / float(v: r.storage_size) * 100.0, _time: now()}))
  |> group()
  |> mean()

spec.description: Average data_size / storage_size ratio across all databases. Values >100% are normal with WiredTiger compression — the logical data is larger than what's stored on disk. Very low values (<50%) may indicate heavy fragmentation.
spec.title: Storage Utilization %

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "wtcache_current_bytes" or r._field == "wtcache_max_bytes_configured" or r._field == "wtcache_tracked_dirty_bytes")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.description: WiredTiger cache used and dirty bytes vs max configured. Cache eviction pressure starts when dirty bytes stay high.
spec.title: WiredTiger Cache Usage

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "page_faults")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.description: Page faults indicate memory pressure forcing disk reads. Sustained faults degrade latency.
spec.title: Page Faults

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "active_reads" or r._field == "active_writes" or r._field == "queued_reads" or r._field == "queued_writes")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.description: Active reads/writes and queued reads/writes. Queue depth >0 persistently means the server is saturated.
spec.title: Active & Queued Operations

spec.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb_db_stats")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.node_type == "PRI")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.db_name == "${database}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "data_size" or r._field == "storage_size" or r._field == "index_size")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "hostname", "rs_name", "node_type", "db_name"])

from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mongodb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "assert_regular" or r._field == "assert_warning" or r._field == "assert_msg" or r._field == "assert_user")
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({assertionType: r._field, count: r._value}))
  |> group()
